user.title: Pick your street
user.description: Waste collection of Gosp-Com SRL in Târgu Secuiesc, Lunga, Săsăuși and Tinoasa. You get the next collection, a countdown, a calendar and an evening reminder. With your Gosp-Com account you also get the bills: the amount due, the last bill and a message when a new one comes.

data_description.notify_service: E.g. notify.mobile_app_my_phone. Leave empty to only get the gospcom_waste_reminder event.
data_description.email: Sign in to www.gosp-com.ro/account to get your bills too. Leave empty if you only need the collection days.
data_description.password: When changing other settings, leave empty to keep the saved password.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Gosp-Com again
reauth_confirm.description: Gosp-Com no longer accepts the saved password. Enter the account's e-mail address and password.
